title: The impact of ESG performance on OFDI mode choice: the role of total factor productivity
core_idea: Constructs a theoretical model linking firms' ESG performance to their outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) mode choice via effects on total factor productivity, and empirically tests this model using data from Chinese listed companies while incorporating ESG advantages into OLI theory and the productivity threshold of new-new trade theory.
tldr: Develops and empirically tests a model examining how ESG performance, through its impact on total factor productivity, influences firms' OFDI mode choice and integrates ESG into OLI and new-new trade frameworks using Chinese listed firm data.
